pages.text: Every great foe and every kind of dangerous place has a page here, locked until you earn it.$(li)Step into a lair, or set eyes on its master, and the page opens.$(li)Bring the master down and the last page fills in.$(br2)Each page ends with a $(l)Counter$(): the one thing to remember when the fight starts.

Every master in this world is built for a full party of four. Its hits are heavy and its fights are long. A combat roll ($(k:keybinds.combat_roll.roll)) makes you untouchable for a moment: learn the big blows and roll through them.$(br2)Pages you have not earned stay locked. Go and look.
